snippet.title: Chukgwi Game short trailer
snippet.description:
Where the livings dare not tread, an incomplete shaman walks.
Armed with nothing but a Spirit Gauge and a Voice that must not falter.

This is ChukGwi, the Voice-Controlled Korean Folk Horror Experience.

Please prepare a microphone. We need your Actual Voice :)
